claims.evidence: The witness identified the brand as Mongoose from the frame.
Photo 0 shows a white front fork with suspension.
The witness saw a rear derailleur, but the presence of a front derailleur or the full gear range was not confirmed.
The age of the bicycle cannot be determined from photos.
The witness noted that the condition of the gear shifting and the effectiveness of the brakes were not shown.
The witness noted that hidden rust was not shown.
Remote inspection cannot confirm if components are original to the factory build.

risks.proof: A video clip of the bike being pedaled while shifting through the entire gear range.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a full derailleur and cable replacement

risks.proof: A video showing the wheels spinning freely and then stopping immediately upon brake engagement.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring new brake pads and cables

risks.proof: A video showing the front fork compressing and rebounding smoothly under weight.
risks.if_unproven: as a rigid fork with no suspension value

risks.risk: Structural frame damage or internal rust
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the frame welds and the bottom bracket area.
risks.if_unproven: as a damaged frame with scrap value only

proof_requests: Video of the bicycle shifting through all gears while being pedaled.
Video demonstrating the effectiveness of both front and rear brakes.
Video showing the front suspension travel (compression and rebound).
Close-up photos of the frame welds and any areas with potential rust.
response.reason: The witness has identified the item as a Mongoose mountain bike, which allows for a worst-case valuation despite the seller's contradictory claim that it is a Roadmaster. It will be priced as a base-model Mongoose with non-functional mechanical parts until proof is provided.
